title: Extractor error match should explicitly handle AuthError variants
description:
In crates/kithd/src/extractors.rs lines 100-103, the match on AuthError uses catch-all '_' instead of explicitly matching the expected WhoIsFailed variant returned by classify(). This violates Rust exhaustiveness checking and makes the code fragile to future AuthError additions. If someone adds a new AuthError variant in the future, this code won't compile-fail; the new variant silently becomes Internal.

Current code:
```rust
match e {
    kith_core::AuthError::Unauthorized => CallerRejection::Unauthorized,
    _ => CallerRejection::Internal,
}
```

Should be explicit about WhoIsFailed and defensive about unexpected variants.
